title: Current qualification truth: dev11 hidraw generation guard, clean live target pending
summary: dev9 remains Current Library. CODEX-PC independently reviewed dev10 and marked the strong stale-generation claim NOT_PROVEN because hidraw matching was path-based. dev11 snapshots pre-existing hidraw class-object identity, requires a new/rebound class generation under the selected HID interface, and keeps the selected USB devnum stable through HID/hidraw waits. Its forcing regression fails dev10 and passes dev11; clean target-host evidence is still pending.
invariants: dev9 remains the Current Library semantic/FIDO baseline.
dev10 fixed asynchronous device -> HID -> hidraw publication timing but did not independently identify hidraw class generation.
CODEX-PC reply REQ-00000901 marked dev10's cannot-accept-stale-generation claim NOT_PROVEN.
dev11 snapshots pre-existing hidraw class-entry identity and rejects those class generations for the current run.
A dev11 hidraw candidate must be newly published/rebound, resolve under the selected HID interface, have a matching /dev/hidrawN node, and the selected USB devnum must remain stable.
tests/test_live_hidraw_generation_guard.sh fails against dev10 because stale hidraw7 is accepted after path reuse, and passes against dev11 only after class rebind.
The existing stale USB generation guard and delayed-binding wait regression continue to pass.
A clean live PASS still requires current presenter UDC ownership, new CAFE:F1D0 generation, HID class 03 and matching new/rebound hidraw generation.
libfido2, browser/WebAuthn and relying-party acceptance remain later gates.
procedure: Run the clean dev11 live qualifier on an idle dummy_udc.0 with the locked dependency closure.
If a phase times out, inspect persisted Raw Gadget trace and kernel/sysfs diagnostics before changing provider semantics.
After HID/hidraw PASS, qualify libfido2 and browser/WebAuthn separately.

provenance.claim: Validation records package-side passes, Raw Gadget substrate, invalidated dev8 observation, dev9 generation guard and pending clean live acceptance.
dev10 records the delayed binding race, bounded waits, regression result and still-pending clean target acceptance.
dev11 closes the independent hidraw-generation evidence gap and records forcing regression results.
